name: Alessia Romano
bio:
Alessia Romano's career in motorsport public relations began unexpectedly after a chance encounter at a local karting event. Originally a journalist covering local sports, she quickly recognized the untapped potential for strategic communication within racing. Her pragmatic approach, honed through years of navigating the often-turbulent world of motorsport, has earned her a reputation for delivering results, even under intense pressure.

Alessia believes in building genuine relationships with both the media and the racing community. Her focus is always on crafting authentic narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike. She's particularly adept at handling sensitive situations and ensuring that the team's message remains consistent and positive. What sets Alessia apart is her ability to remain calm and collected, even when dealing with the inevitable dramas of the racing world, a trait highly valued by the CRG Racing Team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Alessia is a well-dressed woman with a warm smile and a commanding presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Insists on having a strong espresso before any major press conference.
Has a lucky scarf she wears to every race.
